title: The Smiling Crocodile | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: The Smiling Crocodile Located in Discovery Island at Disney's Animal Kingdom Theme Park Chomp on croco-licious dishes sure to tame ferocious appetites! Enjoy our lip-smacking menu items, including Pulled Pork Cheese Arepa with Plantain Chips, and cold beverages.View Menu American Quick Service Kiosk Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Operating Hours – 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM Valid admission required.
